name: screen-recorder
description: Windows 11 螢幕錄影 + 加速匯出工具（Bun + FFmpeg）

scripts.build: bun run scripts/make-icon.ts && bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --windows-icon=./assets/icon.ico --windows-title=ScreenRecorder --windows-description="Screen recorder with sped-up export" --windows-version=1.0.0.0 ./src/main.ts ./src/tray-worker.ts --outfile ./dist/ScreenRecorder.exe && bun run scripts/set-gui-subsystem.ts ./dist/ScreenRecorder.exe
scripts.build:console: bun run scripts/make-icon.ts && bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --windows-icon=./assets/icon.ico --windows-title=ScreenRecorder --windows-description="Screen recorder with sped-up export" --windows-version=1.0.0.0 ./src/main.ts ./src/tray-worker.ts --outfile ./dist/ScreenRecorder-console.exe
scripts.dist: bun run build && bun run scripts/copy-ffmpeg.ts
